artworks.title: Villagers Skating on a Frozen Pond
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a village setting. The viewpoint is slightly downward. The horizon, marked by small structures and trees, is in the far distance. The drawing uses soft pencil strokes and shading to depict trees, buildings, and figures. Three figures are carrying bundles of sticks. More figures and trees can be seen. An old building is at the center right. The color palette is muted browns and grays. The sky has a few small birds.

artworks.title: Riverscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: graphite and stumping with scratching-out on white prepared paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 8.1 x 13.5 cm (3 3/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon showing cloudy skies. There are trees and a distant building along the horizon. The brushstroke technique is detailed, with fine lines defining trees and the landscape's texture. In the foreground, figures are gathered near an old tree. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. Water flows over rocks below a hill with a tree line. In the distance, subtle architectural structures are visible under a soft sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Peasants before an Inn
artworks.medium: graphite and stumping with scratching-out on white prepared paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 8.1 x 13.5 cm (3 3/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a pastoral scene. The composition includes a man walking with an ox under trees on the left. In the center, there is a path leading to figures near a rocky, vegetated wall with windows. The drawing features detailed trees, crosshatched strokes for foliage, and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Saint Gaetano of Thiene
artworks.medium: etching touched with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure seated on a cloud, looking upwards. He has short hair, a beard, and wears flowing robes. A halo surrounds his head. Below him are a child and a smaller figure, possibly an angel. Above are cherub-like figures in the clouds. In the background, there is an elaborate building with human figures near it, seemingly under construction or renovation.

artworks.title: Bismarckfeier (Celebration for Bismarck)
artworks.medium: hand-colored transfer lithograph on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth and Joseph Bromberg in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective looking towards a large domed building surrounded by a crowd. The horizon line is obscured by the building itself. The top of the dome is highlighted with subtle yellow and flanked by two flag poles with red, yellow, and black flags. The style features loose, sketch-like brushstrokes with a combination of line drawing and watercolor washes. The color palette is light with soft blues in the sky, warm yellows on the dome, and contrasting reds and blacks in the flags. Hints of pale browns and grays illustrate movement and a gathering close to us.

artworks.title: Point Lobos, California
artworks.medium: pen and black and green ink, watercolor, pastel, and graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jill Newhouse in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky coastal outcrop with windswept trees on top. The viewpoint is elevated, capturing the rugged landscape. The horizon is suggested by distant hills or mountainous formations toward the upper right, blending into the sky. The style features expressive brushstrokes showcasing rock textures and tree twists. The color palette includes earthy tones like brown, blue, and green, contrasting with the light color of the paper representing the sea and sky.

artworks.title: Dance in a Village Square
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. Several individuals are shown engaged in various activities. Two figures appear to be conversing, while others are dressed elegantly and participating in dance or socializing. In the foreground, two figures are playing instruments, one likely a guitar. The background includes architectural elements like a building with an overhang and a sign with text. The image conveys movement and social interaction, with shading and details characteristic of a period drawing.

artworks.title: Dance in a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite and squared in graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing showing multiple full-body figures engaged in various activities. Central in the foreground, two figures, a man and a woman, appear to be interacting closely; the man is standing with one hand on his hip, wearing historical attire with breeches and a vest, while the woman beside him is in a dress with embellishments. To the left, three figures are seated around a table; an adult appears to be caring for a child, with the other adult figure draped in fabric. On the right, a group of figures is depicted ascending or descending a staircase, dressed in historical attire. The setting indicates an ornate interior space, possibly a grand hall, with large architectural features like columns and draped curtains adding depth and texture to the composition. The background is filled with architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Tale of the Cooper's Wife
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalks with stumping on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a large barrel. The drawing illustrates an indoor setting featuring a large barrel, with other objects like a woven basket on the wall and an overturned stool or similar structure on the floor. The area has a rustic ambiance. The use of graphite or charcoal gives it a soft, textured quality, and highlights a monochromatic palette, with emphasis on texture and form.

artworks.title: Olindo and Sophronia Saved by Clorinda
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in a historical European city focused on a statue. The scene includes numerous figures and animals, with an atmosphere suggesting a busy market or public gathering with a statue of a poised, draped figure standing on a pedestal. There are horses with riders, with some in historical attire. A domed structure with detailed architecture lies in the background, adding an element of grandeur with tall spires in the distance. Many figures are engaged in activities like observing the statue, talking, or moving through the plaza. The sky is painted with subtle hues, and the color palette consists of earth tones, blues, and grays, lending an antiquated feel to the illustration.

artworks.title: Oriental Woman with a Waterpipe
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a garden setting. One person, a woman with dark hair and a colorful scarf, is sitting on a curved sofa holding a hookah hose. She wears a pink dress and earrings. The other person, a man in a red fez hat and white and blue clothing, is standing next to her holding the hookah. A small table with cups is beside the sofa. The background shows lush greenery with trees and a white stone column.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Pyramid and Classical Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on thin laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image show a landscape with architectural features, trees, and figures viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A structure resembling a ruin or an old building can be seen in the distance along with hills. Two small figures are present in the foreground. The ink lines provide texture and depth to the elements in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia, giving an antique appearance. The composition includes trees on the right and architectural elements on the left, framed by an open sky.

artworks.title: Pastoral Landscape with a Waterfall and a Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view with an elevation, revealing a horizon with a classical structure on the left side. The foreground includes shrubbery and a path, while the middle ground features tall trees outlined with delicate ink strokes. A waterfall is visible on the right. The scene is depicted in sepia-toned ink on paper, giving it an antique appearance.

artworks.title: Animals in a Stable
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene depicted from a direct point of view. The horizon is subtly indicated by lighter tones of the sky, with trees and rugged terrain defining its line. The illustration uses expressive brushstrokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily in sepia tones, giving the artwork a warm, vintage feel. A figure dressed in rustic attire is mid-stride, with a cow reclining and a horse standing with its back turned. A small animal, possibly a cat, is curled up to the right. Dark lines in the background suggest movement among the trees, adding depth and tension to the image.

artworks.title: Camel Caravan
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of camels laden with goods. The camels are depicted carrying large loads on their backs, possibly wrapped in fabric or containers. The drawing shows several camels in a realistic style, trekking across a slightly undulating terrain. The use of reddish-brown tones gives a warm and cohesive look. The focus is on the camels, showcasing details like their humps and expressions, in a composition that conveys movement and direction. There are figures next to some of the camels, possibly tending to them.

artworks.title: A Game of Cards [recto]
artworks.medium: gray wash with touches of pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals around a table, engaged in an activity. The scene captures the upper half of three individuals and the full bodies of two seated individuals. One person is partially visible behind others. One man stands in the background and wears a long coat. The seated individuals include two women and a man, dressed in elaborate 18th-century clothing. One woman leans on the table, reaching her hand forward, while another looks at the man holding something. Their facial expressions are composed. A small dog and a cat are also present. The room has an open window, light draping, and a candelabra, creating an elegant setting.

artworks.title: Oriental Lovers [verso]
artworks.medium: gray wash and pen and gray ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting closely together on a bed. One person appears to be female with delicate facial features and long hair covered by a headscarf, wearing a long dress. The other person appears to be male with a mustache and wearing a turban, a tunic-style garment, a belt, and striped pants. Both are turned towards each other, with one arm around the other's shoulders. The room has a tiled floor and a large window with multiple panes. Above them, there is a shelf on the background wall with pottery items, including bowls and a pitcher.

artworks.title: Saint Luke at His Easel and Four Expressive Heads
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Andrea Celesti
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] reworked in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.3 x 13.1 cm (7 3/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist receiving inspiration. The upper portion shows a seated artist holding a paint palette and a drawing tool, looking up at a small winged figure hovering above a canvas. The winged figure appears to be guiding the artist's hand. The lower portion features sketches of four bearded heads with quick, expressive lines and shading. The drawing uses sepia-like ink and has fluid lines and textures, illustrating creative inspiration.

artworks.title: Lady Seated on a See-Saw
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a seated position. The figure leans slightly to the left, with one leg extended outward and the other bent at the knee. His left arm reaches forward while the right arm is bent, holding an elongated object. The individual's facial features are not detailed, and the hair appears short or tied back. The person is dressed in a loose shirt and trousers. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure and clothing folds. No other objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Monument to King George I
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk, heightened with white on prepared paper; partially pricked for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring grand columns with Corinthian capitals supporting a large structure resembling a temple or palace. The scene includes statues of horses and human figures, intricate carvings, and classical motifs. A dome-like structure with detailed decoration is visible at the top. The columns are arranged to create depth and grandeur. Trees and foliage in the background suggest an open or exterior setting. The drawing is characterized by precise linework and shading, creating a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Monument to William Chancellor Cowper
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper; partially pricked for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate classical scene. The image depicted a large architectural structure, resembling a grand portico or triumphal arch, adorned with sculptures and framed by trees. In front of the structure, there are figures engaged in various activities. The drawing captures the flowing robes and gestures of these figures, surrounded by trees and foliage. The composition is set against a backdrop of hills and buildings, adding depth. The artwork is executed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: View of a Waterfall through a Ravine
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with scratching-out on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view looking up through a steep, narrow gorge towards an open sky in the upper third of the composition. A building is partially hidden among lush green vegetation on a rocky outcrop in the distance. The style features detailed brushstrokes capturing textures of rocky cliffs, foliage, and water in the gorge. The color palette includes natural tones like earthen browns, grays, vibrant greens, and soft blues in the sky.

artworks.title: Seated Angel in a Landscape [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The drawing shows a full-body sketch of a person seated, with their upper body slightly turned to the side and their head tilted downward. The individual's facial features are delicately outlined, with an emphasis on closed eyes and a serene expression. The hair is styled in an updo, with a small decorative element or bow near the top. They are draped in flowing garments that fall smoothly over the contours of their body, while their right hand holds an object close to them, and their left hand rests on their lap. The background features faint sketch lines suggesting an outdoor setting, with trees and clouds. There are no visible jewelry or detailed objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures. In the foreground, there is a sketch of a woman in a seated position, reclining slightly with her arm extended to the side. Her face is turned downward, and she has styled hair with a headpiece, draped in flowing garments. Below her, another figure is lying down with outstretched arms. To the right, a standing woman is depicted, looking forward with her hair tied back and wearing layered fabric around her torso. In the upper corners, there are two small circular sketches with faint outlines of figures. The background is lightly shaded, drawing attention to the figures.
